claim: For any finite family of continuous BV closed original complex curves, scalar h continuous on their trace and bounded complex linear operators whose actual resolvent sets contain that trace, the chosen original tagged-RS Dunford values satisfy the typed resolvent sandwich defect identity and the separate-supremum norm bound with the sum of original geometric curve lengths.

conventions.defect: C composed Tf minus Tc composed C
conventions.length: sum_i eVariationOn(f_i,[0,1]).toReal, counting each Fin n occurrence
conventions.suprema: sSup(insert0(norm(H)(trace))); reconstructed trace equals original finite union; insert0 handles empty cycle

obligations.name: Independent original contour definition
obligations.evidence: rectifiableDunford uses taggedContourIntegral of original f_i and h(z)*actual resolvent(T,z); no velocity identity is a defining field or assumption.

obligations.name: Continuous integrands and existence
obligations.evidence: h trace continuity and actual resolvent differentiability/continuity give continuous integrands on every original component trace. RS comparison therefore identifies each sum with actual constructed IntegralCycle lineIntegral.

obligations.name: Sandwich sign and typing
obligations.evidence: Raw baseline continuousDefect=C Tf-Tc C and actual resolvent inverse witnesses give C Rf-Rc C=Rc defect Rf; composition direction and source/target spaces match.

obligations.name: Geometric upper bound
obligations.evidence: Arclength representative has Lipschitz constant L. Its genuine coordinate velocity has norm<=L at every interior point: both coordinates differentiable gives actual derivative bound; either missing derivative is zero and one-coordinate Lipschitz bound suffices. Integrating gives constructed velocity-length<=original geometric length. Equality is not assumed or claimed.

obligations.name: Separate supremum factors
obligations.evidence: Baseline actual contour estimate yields velocityLength/(2*pi)*sup|h|*norm(defect)*supnorm(Rc)*supnorm(Rf). Supremum factors and2*pi are nonnegative; replace length by the proved geometric upper bound.

obligations.name: Repeated/empty/constant curves
obligations.evidence: Termwise finite sums count repeated curves. Fin0 integral,length and inserted-zero suprema give zero. Constant curves have geometric0 and constructed Lipschitz0, so velocity integral vanishes.

obligations.name: Canonical h(T) identification
obligations.evidence: These statements use chosen-cycle rectifiableDunford. No winding condition or holomorphic-domain canonical independence theorem is asserted here.

strongest_safe_statement: Original classical tagged-RS chosen-cycle defect identity and geometric length bound are fully proved at frozen hashes. Promote to canonical holomorphic functional calculus only after separately checked zero-winding/Cauchy and canonical identification.
